### Lady Wisdom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lady-wisdom
Passage: Proverbs 8:1-11
Points:
- In contrast to the deceptive entice of folly that lurks in secret, wisdom speaks openly and boldly at the city gates.
- Because wisdom cries out where public commerce occurs, God's guidance equips believers for every sphere of daily life.
- The words of wisdom are upright and entirely devoid of crooked or perverse speech.
- True wisdom and personal righteousness are inseparable, each reinforcing and growing the other.
- Formal education alone cannot produce genuine wisdom unless it is grounded in God's righteous standards.
